Oracle.ArrayConstructorExpression: Oracle has no array type; the generator rejects the construct (SqlCompileNotSupportedException).
Oracle.SubscriptExpression: Oracle has no array subscripts; the generator rejects the construct (SqlCompileNotSupportedException).
Oracle.IntervalLiteralExpression: An interval value has no bound form on Oracle (NUMTODSINTERVAL has no MONTH or YEAR field); the generator rejects the construct (SqlCompileNotSupportedException).

SqlServer.ArrayConstructorExpression: T-SQL has no array type; the generator rejects the construct (SqlCompileNotSupportedException).
SqlServer.SubscriptExpression: T-SQL has no array subscripts; the generator rejects the construct (SqlCompileNotSupportedException).
SqlServer.IntervalLiteralExpression: SQL Server has no interval type; the builder rejects the construct.
SqlServer.UsingJoinCondition: T-SQL has no JOIN ... USING; the builder rejects the construct.

Databricks.ArrayConstructorExpression: Array constructors and subscripts are not supported for Databricks; the builder rejects the construct.
Databricks.SubscriptExpression: Array constructors and subscripts are not supported for Databricks; the builder rejects the construct.

Sqlite.GroupingOperationExpression: GROUPING() is not supported for SQLite (no grouping sets); the builder rejects the construct.
Sqlite.IntervalLiteralExpression: SQLite has no interval type; the builder rejects the construct.
